cast.name: 斯瓦蒂·卡皮拉 Swati Kapila

introduction: LIFE! CAMERA ACTION...is an inspiring story of a a young girl, Reina, who sets off to pursue a career in filmmaking against the wishes of her family and as she tries to make ends meet, Reina begins to see another dream - to prove to her parents that her drive for her dream is sincere and while being born with a personality may be an inherent gift from our parents, but to live as a personality is an achievement of our own and a return gift to our parents. Written by Rohit Gupta
